data.narrative:
Amogy, a Series C climate and energy company that has raised $300M+, is valued at $700M on a post-money basis. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine companies spanning the climate and energy sector, including two public comparables (Enovix and Solid Power) and seven private peers (KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Redwood Materials, and QuantumScape among them).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, using a typical 1.7x multiplier for Series C advancement, implies a valuation of $1.2B. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables yields a median of $1.0B, with peer valuations ranging from $504M (Solid Power) to $3.0B (KoBold Metals). The four peers in the detailed median calculation are KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), Enovix ($1.0B), and Solid Power ($504M).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.4B, with a median cross-check of $1.1B. This represents modest upside from the current $700M post-money, consistent with stage progression norms. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in peer valuations ($504M-$3.0B), reflecting heterogeneous risk profiles and technology maturity within the climate-energy sector, and the limited granularity on peer-stage alignment beyond category-level matching.
